How About a New 1,200-HP Ford Mustang Shelby GT500 To Quench Your Muscle Car Thirst?
10 photos
Photo: Instagram | jesus.spec
You may be tempted to think that there are a few typos in the title. After all, 1,200 horsepower does not sound like the standard output when it comes to this model, and where would you find a new one given that production of the S550 Ford Mustang Shelby GT500 concluded a few years ago?
Well, on the used car market, of course, especially if you know where to look and are patient enough. We recently stumbled upon quite a few such muscle cars that caught our attention, and the one pictured above sits at the very top of the list. That’s because it indeed features a lot more power than the original Bugatti Veyron, and it has a renowned tuner based in the Lone Star State to thank for that.
We are talking about none other than Hennessey, which gave it a jaw-dropping amount of power. The output is not actually rated at 1,200 hp, because this machine actually has 1,204 hp (1,221 ps/898 kW ) courtesy of the Venom 1200 package , and the massively upgraded 5.2-liter supercharged V8 engine now pumps out 902 pound-feet (1,223 Nm) of torque. However, you will need to put E85 in the fuel tank in order to obtain these numbers.
With no mods whatsoever, the S550-based Ford Mustang Shelby GT500 has 760 hp (771 ps/567 kW) and 627 lb-ft (847 Nm) of torque to play with. It hits 60 mph (97 kph) in a little over three seconds, and needs 10.7 seconds officially to complete the standing quarter mile.
Photo: Instagram | jesus.spec Only 66 units of the Venom 1200-equipped Ford Mustang Shelby GT500 saw the light of day, featuring a few other extras besides the neck-snapping power boost, and pictured above is one of them. With 937 miles (1,508 km) on the odometer, this 2022 model year machine is pretty much brand new, so if you wanted to spruce up your weekends, or perhaps daily drives, with something like this, then you have come to the right place.
That’s because this ride is indeed searching for a new home in the United States of America, and besides the aftermarket goodies, it also sports the Carbon Fiber Track Package, the listing reveals. It is finished in white, has several glossy black details, the Hennessey name on the windscreen, the Venom 1200 decals on the side skirt, tinted windows, and other special touches all around. The interior mixes black and white Alcantara and leather upholstery, and looks very good from what we can tell.
How much do you think this Hennessey-tuned Venom 1200 Ford Mustang Shelby GT500 costs? Well, it’s not cheap, that’s for sure, but it’s ridiculously expensive either. At the time of writing, this muscle car had a sticker price of $144,995 attached to it. It’s advertised on social media by @jesus.spec, and the selling dealer says that nationwide shipping is available, albeit likely at an extra cost. So, have you found your next cool ride?
